prospective_status: Frozen from OpenML metadata before downloading feature values or outcomes for these four datasets.
members: Two independently initialized, equal-parameter T-PLE models of the same architecture.
selection: Choose alpha minimizing validation loss for (1-alpha)*member_1 + alpha*member_2; ties prefer the smaller alpha and therefore the first anchor.
split: Deterministic 60/20/20 split, stratified for classification. The method, alpha grid, and test gate are frozen before outcome download.
test_gate: At least 8/12 test wins versus member 1, positive mean test gain versus member 1 in both task families, positive per-dataset mean gain versus member 1 on at least 3/4 datasets, at least 7/12 test wins versus the fixed 50/50 ensemble, and positive overall mean test gain versus the fixed ensemble.
